description: This file defines the ServiceContext class in the OpenMRS API project, responsible for managing and providing access to various system services through dependency injection and AOP proxies. It includes methods for retrieving, setting, and managing services, handling module-specific services, and coordinating Spring application context interactions.

classes.name: ServiceContext
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for managing and providing access to OpenMRS system services, handling dependency injection via Spring, and applying AOP advice and advisors.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of ServiceContext, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: destroyInstance
methods.description: Nullifies the singleton instance, clearing all cached services and proxies, typically invoked during shutdown or refresh.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Provides access to a registered service, waiting if the context is currently refreshing.

methods.name: setService
methods.description: Sets or replaces a service implementation in the context, wrapping it with AOP proxies if needed.

methods.name: setModuleService
methods.description: Registers a module-specific service by class name and instance, loading the class and optionally invoking onStartup.

methods.name: startRefreshingContext
methods.description: Marks the beginning of a context refresh, causing dependent calls to wait.

methods.name: doneRefreshingContext
methods.description: Marks the end of a context refresh, notifying waiting threads.

methods.name: runOpenmrsServiceOnStartup
methods.description: Invokes the onStartup method for services implementing OpenmrsService after context load.

methods.name: getModuleOpenmrsServices
methods.description: Returns all OpenmrsService instances belonging to a specific module package.
